nom: Uriage Eau Thermale Lip Balm, Ultra-Soft Moisturizing Care For Dry Lips

avis.texte: While traveling in another country, my friend had extremely dry, cracked lips and popped into a local pharmacy to asked for their best recommendation. The pharmacist immediately directed her to the Uriage and said it's worth the price. Throughout the rest of the trip and through two other international trips she has raved about this stuff and calls it "magic lips". I couldn't help but tease her about how much she gushes over her "magic lips", but when my lip cracked and nothing seemed to help, I bought some myself. She's right. This stuff is magical. It lasts a long time, I rarely need to reapply. It has little to no frangrance (I'm usually into fruity stuff), but it works to heal and soften better than any lip product I've ever used.

avis.texte: So far it’s amazing! I’ve used it for a few days and this morning when I woke up, I couldn’t remember the last time my lips looked this smooth without a ton of lines in them. I’ve chronically been biting my lips for as long as I can recall. Really trying to stop and seeing such a huge improvement this morning is amazing.

This is my second time purchasing this. I love the consistency of the product. Very moisturizing and light. No weird residue, so it works well by itself or underneath lipstick. It is a little pricier than most chapsticks, but it’s well worth it. I have sensitive skin and it does not irritate me at all. Very happy to be able to buy this again!
Great recommendation from my dermatologist. I have dry lips and when she recommended it I didn’t have high hopes. Turns out it moisturizes without feeling greasy and it lasts.

avis.titre: Love this stuff (never lasts long enough!)
avis.texte: I blow thru this so quickly — in part because I love it and also because it requires a lot of reapplication. Doesn’t “stick”. But it works (great for underneath lip colors, too) and is leaps and bounds better than most drugstore offerings. Doesn’t have that loop effect that balms like Carmex/Chap Stick do, that get you in a cycle of forced reapplying because it’s drying out your lips. Smells nice, feels good.

avis.titre: Nice, but overpriced for what it is
avis.texte: Uriage makes good skincare, and this lip balm is definitely hydrating and feels nice on the lips. However, given the price point, I don’t think it outperforms classic drugstore options. To be honest, I get the exact same (or even better) results from Burt's Bees at a fraction of the cost. It’s a decent product, but it doesn't quite justify the premium price tag for me
This lip balm goes on very smooth on your dry lips. Lasts a long time. I sometimes put it over my lipsticks. I think it's very effective.
My lips are sensitive and easily crack friends suggest this and yet turn out not bad at all..getting better little by little..thankssss

avis.titre: Ein super Pflegestift für extrem trockene Lippen
avis.texte: Habe extrem trockene Lippen durch jahrelange Pflegestifte/Lippenstifte Nutzung. Es gab von anderen Firmen einen Hydro-Pflegestift, jedoch wurde die Rezeptur verändert, wodurch der Feuchtigkeitseffekt nachgelassen hatte. Bei dem Uriage Hydro-Aktiv habe ich den gewünschten Effekt. Auch wenn einige kritisieren, dass sich der Stift schnell verbraucht - dass ist ja normal, wenn die Konsistenz weicher ist. Die Produkte mit höheren Wachsanteil schmieren nur. Dieser Pfegestift ist optimal.

avis.titre: The best lip treatment I’ve ever had
avis.texte: Recommended by my dermatologist, this lipstick is the only thing I’ve found to keep my lips looking plump, rather than dried and shrivelled. And they don’t peel. It’s great.
